time: Tiempo_obs_digital, desde el primer registro digital
pfs_rule: Kaplan-Meier at 365 days; top 3 favourable, bottom 3 unfavourable
tie_break: restricted mean survival time at 365 days; otherwise the model is reserved
score: sum of three consecutive block pUF values
cut: one Youden cut per outer fold, held-out evaluable decisions, lowest cut if tied
landmark: decision day is month x 30, the collapsed month end of the 1019 landmarks; event study day is Tiempo_obs_digital + 1
